title: Power to investigate offences.–Notwithstanding anything contained in the Code of Criminal
text:
78. Power to investigate offences.–Notwithstanding anything contained in the Code of Criminal

Procedure, 1973 (2 of 1974), a police officer not below the rank of [Inspector] shall investigate any
offence under this Act.

2[CHAPTER XII

INTERMEDIARIES NOT TO BE LIABLE IN CERTAIN CASES
